prior_art: Binary incidence rank of W(3,q) for odd prime powers from the symplectic generalized-quadrangle incidence-rank literature (Sin-Xiang; Chandler-Sin-Xiang).
Levi_mechanism: For odd q, q+1 is even and BB^T mod2=[[0,N],[N^T,0]], hence dim Bike_2(Levi)=2 null_F2(N)-1.
boundary: The theorem is for odd prime powers. Even q follows a different incidence-rank law.
